tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind cards and lists (page ground). Never put body text directly on it below 13px.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, dialogs, menus, inputs, top bar and tab bar.

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header row, form section bands, dialog footer, drop zone.

tokens.name: bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Sticky date-group header on phone lists, category chip fill.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of menu items and rows.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Dimmed layer behind dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card, menu and tab-strip borders; top bar and tab bar hairlines.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: Dividers between rows inside a card; neutral badge fill.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of interactive controls: buttons, inputs, chips, search, pager arrows. Kept exactly from the canvas; it is 1.4:1 on bg-surface (1.7:1 dark), under the 3:1 guideline for control borders, so controls must also carry a label, fill or icon. Candidate fix: #a9b0ba light / #4f5864 dark.

tokens.name: line-heavy
tokens.usage: Heaviest non-text line: drag handles, the off track of a switch, dashed drop borders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and amounts on bg-surface, bg-canvas, bg-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Strong secondary text: field labels, chip text, rule usage counts. On bg-surface and bg-subtle.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Secondary text: card subtitles, row context lines, meta. 6.0:1 on bg-surface (light), 6.9:1 (dark).

tokens.name: ink-4
tokens.usage: Icons, placeholders, table header labels, overline captions. 5.4:1 on bg-surface (light), 6.2:1 (dark); at least 4.6:1 on every ground and tint in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Non-text only: pager ellipsis, disabled glyphs, separators. Fails 4.5:1 for text; the canvas used it for overline captions, which now move to ink-4.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, the current tab, links, switches when on, progress fill, the selection stripe. Ink: near-black in light, near-white in dark. 16.7:1 on bg-surface (light), 15.2:1 (dark).

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-tint: active nav, chip that is on, selected menu item, active tab label.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Selected backgrounds: chip that is on, nav item that is on, selected row and card, selected menu item.

tokens.name: brand-border
tokens.usage: Border of a chip that is on and other brand-tint fills.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill (primary button, current page).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus outline with 2px offset on every interactive element. Same as brand (ink).

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button and other brand fills on hover.

tokens.name: brand-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button and other brand fills while pressed.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Filled danger button on hover.

tokens.name: danger-pressed
tokens.usage: Filled danger button while pressed.

tokens.name: bg-pressed
tokens.usage: Secondary and ghost buttons, menu items, rows and chips while pressed (one step past bg-hover).

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Credit amounts (+₹) and gains. Always paired with a + sign, never colour alone.

tokens.name: positive-strong
tokens.usage: Success text: badges on positive-tint, status words like Verified, Done, Created, Checksum OK.

tokens.name: positive-tint
tokens.usage: Success badge fill (Paid, Done, Received, Auto ingested) and the success banner.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, failures, debit-over-limit, overdue words.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Danger badge fill.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Border of destructive secondary buttons.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs-you words (review reasons, Watching), amber badges, Set category chip text. At least 4.8:1 on every ground and tint in both themes.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Amber badge and callout fill, active review filter chip.

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: Border of the active review filter chip.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Body text inside a callout on warning-tint.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Non-text accent for an item being watched: a left stripe on a row.

tokens.name: attention-tint
tokens.usage: Fill paired with attention.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Connection words: links between transactions, loan/lending/dividend records; info badges.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Info badge fill.

tokens.name: neutral-ink
tokens.usage: Text of neutral (grey) badges on line-soft.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Text inside an info banner on info-tint.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Text inside a danger banner on danger-tint.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Category and chart colour. First series. Never the only carrier of meaning: always label the series.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Category and chart colour. Second series. Never the only carrier of meaning: always label the series.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Category and chart colour. Third series. Never the only carrier of meaning: always label the series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Category and chart colour. Fourth series. Never the only carrier of meaning: always label the series.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Category and chart colour. Fifth series. Never the only carrier of meaning: always label the series.

tokens.name: chart-rest
tokens.usage: Category and chart colour. 'Everything else' bucket and inactive series. Never the only carrier of meaning: always label the series.

tokens.name: accent-mint
tokens.usage: Mint ground for illustration panels.

tokens.name: accent-gold
tokens.usage: Gold fill in illustrations.

tokens.name: accent-gold-strong
tokens.usage: Darker gold edge paired with accent-gold.

styles.name: hero-figure
styles.usage: The one headline number on a screen: net worth on Home, outstanding on a card account. Tabular figures.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Desktop page title only. Phone pages have no body title; the app bar carries it.

styles.name: screen-title
styles.usage: Empty, offline and auth screen headlines; phone sheet hero titles.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: KPI tile values (19px on phone). Tabular figures.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Phone app bar title, sheet and dialog titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card titles, row primary text on phone, rule names.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text: rows, fields, inputs, menus, desktop tables.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Amounts in rows, emphasised values, button-like links.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, field labels (700), card subtitles (500), tabs (13px).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Row context line, balance under amount, badges (700), helper text. The smallest text size.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase section bands, rail groups, table headers (11px). Colour ink-4, never ink-faint.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Smallest bold text: tab bar labels, count bubbles.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Hairline nudges: badge to text, label to helper.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon to text in tight places; chip gaps inside badges row.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between chips in a row, label to input.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Default gap between buttons and chips; menu padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding on desktop; gap inside cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between KPI tiles and stacked sections on phone; phone page padding top.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Phone page side gutter and row horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Card inner padding, gap between page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Desktop page top padding; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gap between major page regions; sheet bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Desktop page side gutter.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Auth form column padding.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Large empty states.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Auth illustration panel padding.

tokens.name: space-56
tokens.usage: Fixed height of top bars and of calendar day cells.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Fixed height of the floating tab bar and of stacked (icon-over-label) buttons.

tokens.name: space-96
tokens.usage: Width of one revealed swipe action.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Keyboard keys, calendar event bars, progress-bar ends in tight cells.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, small icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, search, menu items, segmented control, pager buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, KPI tiles, menus, the desktop selection bar.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Rule and record cards, desktop dialogs, drop zone, auth illustration tiles.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Largest corner: top corners of phone bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Filter chips, category chips, switches, avatars, count bubbles.

shadow.note: Shadows mark things that float above the page. Cards do not get one; borders separate them.

tokens.name: shadow-level-2
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces: menus, dropdowns, popovers, toasts, the floating selection bar.

tokens.name: shadow-level-3
tokens.usage: Highest float: centred dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-up-2
tokens.usage: Stronger upward shadow: phone bottom sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-up-1
tokens.usage: Upward shadow for things docked to the bottom edge: tab bar, docked selection bar.

tokens.name: shadow-level-1
tokens.usage: Lowest float: illustration tiles.

size.note: Fixed heights so controls line up across screens.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons inside rows and card headers (desktop).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Every control: buttons, fields, selects, date fields.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Spare step; no control uses it.

tokens.name: control-xl
tokens.usage: Phone primary actions and sheet footer buttons; the minimum touch target on phone.

tokens.name: container-xs
tokens.usage: Narrowest container: side navigation.

tokens.name: container-sm
tokens.usage: Small container: confirms and short forms.

tokens.name: container-md
tokens.usage: Default container width for dialogs and focused content.

tokens.name: container-lg
tokens.usage: Large container: pickers and lists.

tokens.name: container-xl
tokens.usage: Extra large container: tables.

tokens.name: icon-xs
tokens.usage: Tiny glyph inside a text link, e.g. the + of Add links.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in chips, field carets, small buttons, inline with 12–13px text.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons, bars, rows and menu items.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icons in the phone tab bar, desktop rail and selection bar.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky date-group headers.

tokens.name: z-floating
tokens.usage: Bars that float over content: tab bar, selection bar.

tokens.name: z-backdrop
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, menus.

duration.note: Durations as plain values; easing standard cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1). Respect reduced motion.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, chip toggle.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Menus opening, row selection tint.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Large movements: sheets sliding, swipe-to-dismiss.

tokens.name: dur-loop
tokens.usage: One cycle of a looping indicator (indeterminate progress). Never for transitions.
